# IdentitySubspace { #deep_tensor.IdentitySubspace }

```python
IdentitySubspace(dim: int, device: torch.device = torch.get_default_device())
```

Identity subspace (*i.e.,* no dimension reduction).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**dim**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The dimension of the target density.

<code>[**device**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [torch.device]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [torch.get_default_device()]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The device to carry out computations on.
